reason: The README describes an evidence-driven company and job due-diligence workflow centered on source collection, claim verification, research reports, and interview question generation.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动公司与岗位尽调插件，用于收集来源、管理带证据主张、核验主体并生成报告和面试问题。
summaries.en: An evidence-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin for company and job due diligence that collects sources, manages supported claims, verifies identities, and generates reports and interview questions.

capabilities: Searches through a DeepSeek Harness Web Provider and records resulting sources
Stores evidence-linked claims and generates due-diligence reports and interview questions
Verifies company identity against specified official sources
Exports and imports case data and reports to local files
